metadata.name: Professional Video Prompts: AI Workflow Guide
metadata.description: Video editing prompt cards for review-led, consent-aware workflows.

prompts.title: Cinematic Upgrade
prompts.prompt: Edit this video into a cinematic clip. Keep [subject] unchanged. Improve the lighting to look like [lighting style]. Add [camera movement], [colour style], and [visual mood]. Do not change [what must stay the same].
prompts.best_for: raw footage upgrades and polished social video
acceptance_criteria: The protected subject, scene elements, and constraints are preserved.
The requested change is visually coherent and does not introduce unintended artifacts.
Review the result for consent, brand, and rights requirements before publishing.

prompts.title: Background Replacement
prompts.prompt: Replace the background in this video with [new background]. Keep [subject] exactly as they appear, with the same lighting, movement, and scale. Make the new background match the [mood/time of day] of the original clip.
acceptance_criteria: The protected subject, scene elements, and constraints are preserved.
The requested change is visually coherent and does not introduce unintended artifacts.
Review the result for consent, brand, and rights requirements before publishing.

prompts.title: Object Removal
prompts.prompt: Remove [specific object] from this video. Fill the space naturally using the surrounding [background elements]. Do not alter [subject] or the overall composition.

acceptance_criteria: The protected subject, scene elements, and constraints are preserved.
The requested change is visually coherent and does not introduce unintended artifacts.
Review the result for consent, brand, and rights requirements before publishing.

prompts.title: Outfit Change

Review the result for consent, brand, and rights requirements before publishing.

prompts.title: Time of Day Transformation

prompts.title: Camera Movement Edit

Review the result for consent, brand, and rights requirements before publishing.

prompts.title: Pacing & Rhythm Edit
prompts.prompt: Re-edit the pacing of this video to match the energy of [reference style]. Trim dead space between [actions/sentences]. Keep the key moments at [descriptions]. The final video should feel [punchy/calm/dynamic].
acceptance_criteria: The protected subject, scene elements, and constraints are preserved.
The requested change is visually coherent and does not introduce unintended artifacts.
Review the result for consent, brand, and rights requirements before publishing.

prompts.title: Weather & Environment Effects
prompts.prompt: Add [weather effect] to the environment of this video. The effect should look realistic and [subtle/dramatic]. Keep the main subject completely unchanged. Blend the effect naturally with the existing lighting.

prompts.title: Style Transfer
prompts.prompt: Re-style this video to look like it was filmed in the aesthetic of [reference style/era/brand]. Apply matching [grain/texture/colour/lighting]. Keep [subject] unchanged. The result should feel [desired feeling], without looking like a filter.

prompts.title: B-Roll Generation & Insertion
prompts.prompt: Generate and insert B-roll illustrating [concept/action] when the subject says [specific phrase]. The B-roll style must match the [lighting/aesthetic] of the main clip. Transition back smoothly.

prompts.title: Glitch & Datamosh Effects
prompts.prompt: Apply a [type of glitch] effect at [timestamp/action]. Keep the audio perfectly synced. The distortion should feel [subtle/aggressive] and use [specific colour channels]. Keep the subject recognisable.

prompts.title: Audio-Reactive Visuals
prompts.prompt: Animate [background element/colour/lighting] to react to the beat of the audio. The reaction should be a [pulse/flash/shift] during the [bass/snare/vocal] hits. Maintain the primary focus on the subject.

prompts.title: Typography & Motion Graphics

prompts.title: Stop-Motion Conversion

prompts.prompt: Apply a shallow depth of field, blurring the background. Ensure the subject remains perfectly sharp from [closest point] to [farthest point]. The background bokeh should look like a [lens type] lens.

prompts.title: Seamless Loop Creation
prompts.prompt: Edit this video into a seamless infinite loop. Match the visual positioning and momentum of the final frame exactly with the first frame. Ensure the audio cuts seamlessly without a noticeable jump.
